_doc: Sampling and post-processing for the generative model (Phase 6). The exported gen.json carries these to the browser.
_include_warmup_doc: Train on, and draw timings from, the warm-up trials as well. The owner's warm-up trials couldn't be told apart from the rest (classifier AUC 0.54, 2026-10-09), and no more sessions will be recorded.
_lowpass_doc: The continuous generated path is low-passed before it is rounded to whole pixels once (the rounding recreates the pixel steps). Lower removes more of the network's wobble but also real tremor; `python -m models.generative tune --write` picks it on the validation sessions. 0 disables.
_start_ramp_doc: The generated path's small offset from the cursor at onset fades out over this fraction of the movement (pinning it at once would be a 1 ms jump).
_end_fit_doc: The network also predicts where the movement ends relative to the target (in target-size units). similarity: rotate and scale the whole path about its start to end there; ramp: bend the path from end_ramp_start of its duration; none: ignore the prediction.
